items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: I went over there with Nicole Barclay, who owned the Blue Star Records, I think. I went to visit her.

ctx.x: people, you know what I mean, because there were too many, they'd spoil. They knew I was going to have a birthday party and so the cook on the ship baked me a birthday cake. The guys were coming to enjoy themselves and I had the room and everything. All of a sudden I left the room open and locked all my bags and left them there and went to Paris, just like that. When they came they called all over Paris and everything. I went over there with Nicole Barclay, who owned the Blue Star Records, I think. I went to…
One thing I don't understand. Reading all the Psalms, what did that do to you?
